message:
ERROR 25P02 (in_failed_sql_transaction) current transaction is aborted, commands ignored until end of transaction block

    query: SELECT p0."id", p0."name", p0."description", p0."price", p0."stock", p0."image_url", p0."category", p0."compare_at_price", p0."ratings", p0."specifications", p0."status", p0."available", p0."store_id", p0."inserted_at", p0."updated_at" FROM "products" AS p0 WHERE (p0."id" = $1)
